title: Remove Stickers from member Spotlight pages
detail: Owner ask: take Stickers out. The sticker layer no longer renders on a Spotlight page, the Stickers section is gone from the appearance panel, and the writer, reader, allowlist and validator are deleted. Any stored meta.spotlight.stickers is left in the database untouched. Top friends follows in its own change.

verify.evidence: Neither block is offered or rendered.
